Description

If you love to play badminton and you live in north west London, then you’ll want to play badminton at YMCA St Albans. The badminton courts here are exquisite, so come and give them a try. These courts are perfect for amateur badminton players as well as seasoned professionals so YMCA St Albans really is one of the best facilities around. Clear and well maintained badminton markings in the spacious sports hall make this an excellent badminton venue.

If public transport isn't your thing, then parking facilities are available where a pay and display system is operated. The specific prices may vary depending on the time of day, so if you'd like to know this information then please contact the venue.

Customers will be pleased to know that the venue operates a pay-as-you-play booking system. This means sports enthusiasts can just turn up and play depending on availability and book on a pay as you play basis. This method avoids the monthly membership charges and gives you the freedom to play as and when you like, without the commitment of a weekly game or a membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at YMCA St Albans? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

The venue is situated near St Albans city station. From there it is a short walk to the facility which works out well for a gentle warm down after your booking.
